<Nine Dragon Symbols has activated>
<Nine Dragon Symbols has begun refining the Dragon Ancestor's Blood Essence, enhancing its potency>
The blood essence surged with such immense energy that Yuan felt his body swelling like an overfilled balloon.
As always, it came hand in hand with unbearable pain-but by now, Yuan was accustomed to it.
His tolerance had grown to such extremes that even having his limbs torn from his body would hardly faze him.
While Yuan absorbed the Dragon Ancestor's blood essence, the Primordial Phoenix returned to the Supreme Heaven to report the situation to the Celestial Emperor.
"The Immortal Monarch, huh?" The Celestial Emperor was not surprised by the Immortal Monarch's return.
"That man claimed to be your enemy.
Is that true?" The Primordial Phoenix suddenly asked.
The Celestial Emperor fell silent for a moment before responding, "Honestly, I don't consider him an enemy."
"Excuse me?" The Primordial Phoenix raised his eyebrows in a puzzled manner.
The Celestial Emperor continued, "I have never met him personally, much less spoken to him, so I don't have any feelings or hatred toward him.
However, he is someone that shouldn't exist someone that I must get rid of."
"May I ask why?" asked the Primordial Phoenix.
"It is just one of my many duties as the Celestial Emperor," he calmly replied, offering a vague answer.
"In that case, should I eliminate him?" the Primordial Phoenix asked.
The Celestial Emperor shook his head.
"No... not yet.
He's like an explosive with an overly sensitive trigger, and the slightest touch could set off a catastrophic detonation.
Wait for my orders.
I'll let you know when it's safe."
"I understand.
What about the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans?
Although I'm very confident they won't leave our side, there's always a chance for something to go awry."
"While the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans are very useful, they won't pose any threat even if they were to join the Immortal Monarch's side.
That said, I won't tolerate any betrayal, especially if it's to help that calamity."
"I can eliminate those who betray us, right?" The Primordial Phoenix asked.
The Celestial Emperor calmly nodded.
"Very well." A cold smile appeared on the Primordial Phoenix's face.

Sometime later, after the Primordial Phoenix left, the Celestial Emperor made his way to his private world, where he'd spend the next several days staring at a screen that displayed several slumbering entities.
"The Immortal Monarch... the bastard who dared to lay his filthy paws on you has returned.
And as much as I want to rip his throat out, I cannot directly touch him, as my lack of influence could ruin your revenge..."
The Celestial Emperor's body suddenly stiffened as his eyes caught something in the display.
"It can't be..." he muttered, his frame trembling.
Though subtle, one of the entities had stirred ever so slightly-a sign that it was beginning to awaken.
Time passed quickly, and in the blink of an eye, six months had passed since the meeting.
After the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans' discussion with each other ended, they left the Undying Fiery Summit to return home and continue discussing Yuan's offer with the rest of their family.

chapters.title: Chapter 2133: A Month Before the Deadline
paragraphs: "It's already been half a year, and not a single clan has sided with the Young Master..." Feng Yuxiang sighed, her voice echoing softly through the empty chamber.
The words of the Primordial Phoenix still lingered in her mind, gnawing at her optimism day after day.
She couldn't help but wonder what would happen if none of the Royal Phoenix Clans chose to side with Yuan and instead continued their allegiance to the Celestial Emperor.
A few days later, the chamber doors creaked open, and a lone figure stepped inside.
Feng Yuxiang turned, expecting to see one of the clan leaders-only to be disappointed.
"Oh... It's just you," she muttered, her tone tinged with disappointment. "What do you want?"
Feng Haoyu bowed slightly and said, "I wish to swear my allegiance to the Immortal Monarch-or rather, to reaffirm my loyalty to him."
"That's cool and all, but what about your family? Where are they?"

Feng Haoyu let out a heavy sigh. "It's complicated. While most of my clan wishes to follow the Immortal Monarch, they can't simply pledge loyalty without first seeing what the others decide. In other words... they're waiting."
"That's bullshit," Feng Yuxiang said with a deep frown. "Why should it matter what the others do? The Ten Royal Phoenix Clans are separate clans, not one united background."

Feng Haoyu shook his head. "You probably don't know this since you were barely with us, but despite the name, the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan holds the most authority. In the end, their word is what carries the most weight."
"Why is it that way?" Feng Yuxiang asked.

"Because originally, there was only one Royal Phoenix Clan-the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan. But after the Ten Royal Dragon Clans were established, they chose to expand their influence by mirroring the dragon clans, creating the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans.

The dragon and phoenix clans had been rivals since ancient times. Unwilling to fall behind the Ten Royal Dragon Clans, the phoenixes established their own Royal Clans, selecting the most qualified among them to rise to that position.
"So you're telling me that unless the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan sides with the Young Master, the others will not do so?"
"Well, it's not impossible, but it's very unlikely."

"I cannot fathom why they would choose the Celestial Emperor over the Immortal Monarch. Yes, the Celestial Emperor is powerful and influential, but their bloodlines would benefit far more under the Immortal Monarch," Feng Yuxiang said with a sigh, shaking her head in frustration.

"Honestly," Feng Haoyu replied, "while the Immortal Monarch was a legendary figure in the past, countless years have passed since then. To the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans, who never had any direct ties to him, he doesn't really hold a place in their eyes."
Hearing this, Feng Yuxiang fell silent.

Unlike the Heavenly White Tiger Clan, the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans shared no ties with the Immortal Monarch. The Heavenly White Tiger Clan's ancestor had been one of the Nine Divine Supremes, so their reverence was only natural.
While the Immortal Monarch did have Feng Yuming, another Primordial Phoenix, she held no direct connection to the other phoenix clans and had spent most of her life wandering alone.

Feng Yuxiang had to admit that, although the Immortal Monarch was immensely influential, his era had long since passed and even during the height of his reign, not everyone chose to respect or revere him. "What will you do if your family refuses to side with the Young Master?" Feng Yuxiang suddenly asked. Feng Haoyu fell silent, his expression solemn as he pondered. After a moment, he replied, "Honestly, I don't know. I may be the eldest son, but my influence in the clan is limited. There's no realistic chance I could convince them to follow the Immortal Monarch. And unless they exile me for my decision, it's not as if I could simply abandon them, either."
"While we're on the subject... do you mind if I ask you a question?"
Feng Yuxiang nodded.
"What will the Immortal Monarch do if the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans-if my clan refuses to side with him? Will he go to war with them, too?"

"I cannot tell you what he might or might not do because I am not the Young Master. That said, he's a very reasonable individual, and he's not someone who will attack the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans without a good reason. Even if we do end up fighting them, I can guarantee you that he won't make you fight your family."
"That's good enough for me." Feng Haoyu nodded.
'If we do end up fighting my family... what will I do?' he wondered inwardly.
Another five months slipped by.
Yet, with only a single month remaining before the deadline, not one of the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans had appeared at the summit-let alone to contend for the first three positions.
Meanwhile, at the Rising Phoenix Clan, the Grand Elder approached Feng Lingyang.
"Clan leader... have you come to a decision yet? There's only one month left, and as far as I am aware, none of the other clans have sided with the Immortal Monarch yet."
"No, not yet..." she sighed. "I apologize for being indecisive. I am such a useless leader."

"I want to side with the Immortal Monarch, but doing so will definitely paint a target on my back for the others to aim. However, if I don't side with him, we would not only have to deal with the Immortal Monarch and his powerful allies, but we'll also have to fight my son."
"Grand Elder, if you were in my position, what would you do?" she asked, gazing at him intently.
"I would side with the Immortal Monarch," the Grand Elder replied without the slightest hesitation, leaving Feng Lingyang utterly dumbfounded.
He smiled and continued, "Honestly, if it weren't for my position, just like the Young Lord, I would've already sworn my loyalty to him."
"T-That was a quick response... almost as if you were ready to say it at any moment. Can you explain your reasoning?" she asked. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2134: The Ten Royal Phoenix Clans' Decision
paragraphs: "My reasoning, huh? It's actually quite simple. I know you're worried about the other Royal Phoenix Clans, but once we side with the Immortal Monarch, their stance won't matter anymore. In fact, even the title of 'Royal Clan' will lose its weight," said the Grand Elder.
"What...?" Feng Lingyang's eyes widened. His reasoning wasn't what she expected, yet the more she considered it, the more sense it made.

The Grand Elder continued, "Even if we're the only clan to follow the Immortal Monarch, the others won't dare touch us with him behind us. But if we side with the Celestial Emperor, we'll inevitably end up clashing with the Immortal Monarch-and if you ask me, I believe his strength surpasses the Celestial Emperor's."
"Is it because of Dragon Goddess Yeyou?" Feng Lingyang asked.

"Not just her," he replied. "Though he didn't state it outright, I believe-based on his words-that other Divine Supremes have also survived. And if the Immortal Monarch defeats the Celestial Emperor, our Rising Phoenix Clan will undoubtedly soar to the top, where we won't even need the title of 'Royal Clan." "That's just pure speculation, and you can say the same thing for the others. If the Celestial Emperor defeats the Immortal Monarch, that would undoubtedly spell the end for our Rising Phoenix Clan."
"It all comes down to whether you want to believe in the Celestial Emperor or the Immortal Monarch." The Grand Elder sighed.
Feng Lingyang didn't give a response. Instead, after a long moment of silence, she said, "I'm going to the Undying Fiery Summit."
"I'll come with you."
Sometime later.
"Mother? Grand Elder?" Feng Haoyu's face lit up as he saw the two enter the chamber.
Feng Lingyang's gaze swept across the room before settling on Feng Yuxiang.
"Where is the Immortal Monarch?" she asked.
"He hasn't returned yet. If you have any questions, I'll be more than willing to answer them."
"I would like to know why the Celestial Emperor and the Immortal Monarch are enemies. What started the feud between them?"
"That's..." Feng Yuxiang began, only to close her mouth again, realizing she had no answer to give.

"I'm sorry-I don't know the exact cause. But what I can say with certainty is that it was the Celestial Emperor who showed hostility first. He cursed my Young Master even though they've never met each other before."

Feng Lingyang raised her eyebrows and replied in a doubtful tone, "The Celestial Emperor cursed the Immortal Monarch even though they've never met before? That's hard to believe and completely irrational."
"I understand your skepticism, and I am just as puzzled, but it's the truth. Have you heard about the incident at the Dragon Spiral Mountain recently?
"You mean when the Celestial Emperor attacked the Holy Dragon Clan? I am aware of the incident, but nobody knows the reasoning behind his action."
"It's related to my Young Master," Feng Yuxiang revealed.
"Seriously...?" Those present stared at her with wide eyes.
"If you want to know more, you'll have to ask my Young Master himself."
Feng Lingyang nodded, "Okay."
While they waited for Yuan to return, Feng Haoyu approached Feng Lingyang and asked, "Mother, has the clan reached a decision yet?"
"As you know, the majority of the clan are in support of siding with the Immortal Monarch, but in the end
"It's all up to you," Feng Haoyu interrupted.
"I have also made a decision, but I want to know the reasoning behind their enmity first."
Time continued to pass, and in the blink of an eye, an entire year had passed since the end of the meeting.
A few days before the deadline, the other Royal Phoenix Clans returned to the Undying Fiery Summit.
"Where's the Immortal Monarch?" They asked upon their arrival.
"He's not here yet, but he should arrive soon," said Feng Yuxiang.

"Feng Lingyang, did the Rising Phoenix Clan swear their loyalty to the Immortal Monarch already?" The leader of the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan questioned her after seeing that she'd arrived before them.
"No." Feng Lingyang replied with a simple and straightforward answer.
"Are you sure? I heard that you arrived a month early," pressed the leader of the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan.
"So what?"
The atmosphere in the chamber grew heavy, tension pressing down on everyone present.
But it shattered the moment the door opened and a lone figure stepped inside, drawing every gaze in the room.
However, it wasn't Yuan.
"What are you doing here? Weren't you clear about siding with the Celestial Emperor? Or have you changed your mind?" Feng Yuxiang asked the Primordial Phoenix, who had just entered the chamber.

The Primordial Phoenix sneered. "In your dreams. I'm only here to watch the show-and to savor the disappointment on the Immortal Monarch's face when he realizes that he's no longer relevant in this day and age."
He looked around the room and continued, "So, where's the Immortal Monarch?"
"He'll arrive as soon as he's done with his business."
"He's the one who made the deadline, yet he's the last to show up? It's almost like he doesn't even care." "Calm down, little bird. It's not like I am late."
A calm voice suddenly resounded.
"What?" The Primordial Phoenix and everyone else in the chamber turned toward the entrance-only to see Yuan standing there, having appeared out of thin air.
"The hell? How long has he been there? I didn't sense a thing until he spoke!"
Everyone in the chamber was shaken by his complete lack of presence.
"This bastard... what has he done in the past year? He feels like an entirely different person!"
Though none of them could explain it, they all felt it. Something within Yuan had changed drastically, and he was vastly different from when they last saw him a year ago.
Yuan ignored their stares and strode unhurriedly to the center of the chamber.

His eyes swept across the gathered phoenixes as he spoke in a calm, clear voice, "So, have you reached a decision? Will you continue to serve the Celestial Emperor, or will you stand beneath my banner?" (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2135: The Ten Royal Phoenix Clans' Decision(2)
paragraphs: "Before we begin, I would like to ask you something."
Feng Lingyang suddenly stepped forward.
"Go ahead." Yuan calmly nodded.
"Why are you enemies with the Celestial Emperor?"
"A good question. Unfortunately, I do not know the answer to that question."
"What? You don't know why you're enemies with the Celestial Emperor? How's that even possible?" said the leader of the Crimson Rebirth Phoenix Clan.
"I bet you he's making it up," said the Primordial Phoenix.
"What would I gain from making this up? I've never even met the Celestial Emperor. Yet, he placed a curse on me for some reason."
"Are you trying to claim that the Celestial Emperor showed you hostility for no reason? Sorry, but I don't believe that," said the leader of the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan.
The Primordial Phoenix burst into laughter. "You're so desperate to paint the Celestial Emperor as a villain, but all you're doing is making yourself look like a fool!"
He turned to face the others and spoke loudly, "Is this really someone you want to serve?! A jealous, arrogant, and foolish human like him?"
The room fell into silence.

But it did not last long, for it was soon broken by the leader of the Crimson Rebirth Phoenix Clan, who declared firmly, "The Crimson Rebirth Phoenix Clan rejects your offer, Immortal Monarch. We will continue to stand with the Celestial Emperor."
Then, like a chain reaction, the others began voicing their decisions.
"The Immortal Ember Phoenix Clan refuses your offer, Immortal Monarch."
"The Burning Lotus Phoenix Clan also refuses.
"The Radiant Phoenix Clan refuses..."
One after another, the rejections echoed through the chamber, pouring in without pause.
"My Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan rejects your offer."
"Looks like no one's willing to side with you, huh? Just as I predicted," the Primordial Phoenix mocked.
Yet despite the wave of rejections, Yuan remained calm and composed.
Eventually, only a single clan had yet to respond-the one clan that still hadn't refused Yuan's offer.
"Mother..." Feng Haoyu looked at his mother, his face tight with worry.
The others in the chamber turned their glares upon her, and under the crushing weight of their stares, Feng Lingyang swallowed hard, her body trembling.
"What's wrong, Feng Lingyang? We're all waiting for you," said Feng Tianhuang, the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan's leader.
Feng Lingyang closed her eyes and took several deep breaths. When she opened her eyes again, they flickered with resolution.
"The Rising Phoenix Clan will accept your offer, Immortal Monarch," Feng Lingyang declared.
Feng Haoyu and the Grand Elder's faces lit up with joy at her words, while the other clans openly displayed their disappointment and disdain, making no effort to conceal it.
"What is the meaning of this, Feng Lingyang?" Feng Tianhuang stepped forward, her body radiating oppressive pressure.
"Explain yourself!" she demanded.

Feng Lingyang met her gaze steadily. "Why should I need to explain myself? While I am grateful to the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan for allowing us into the ranks of the Royal Phoenix Clans, you do not own us-nor do we owe you an explanation. Still, as a courtesy, I'll tell you. As clan leader, I have an obligation to heed the will of my people, and the vast majority wish to follow the Immortal Monarch. Quite simple, isn't it?"
"You will regret your decision.
"I'll deal with it when that time comes."

Feng Tianhuang sneered. "As much as I'd like to expel the Rising Phoenix Clan from the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans right this moment, protocol must be followed. That said, it will take little effort to see you removed."

"Then allow me to save you the trouble," Feng Lingyang declared. "From this moment onward, the Rising Phoenix Clan renounces its title and withdraws from the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans. From now on, we shall stand as an independent clan once more."
The room fell into stunned silence, the atmosphere growing oppressively heavy. None of the other phoenix clans had ever anticipated such an outcome.

Though none of them spoke aloud, a few secretly admired Feng Lingyang's courage. She had dared to stand up for herself when they could not. In truth, some among them also wished to side with the Immortal Monarch-but fear of the Imperial Vermilion Phoenix Clan and the Primordial Phoenix kept them silent.
"You will not regret your decision," Yuan's voice suddenly rang out, shattering the silence.
"From this moment on, the Rising Phoenix Clan is under my protection. Should anyone dare to harm them, -the Immortal Monarch-will unleash my full power to destroy the offender."
Yuan's words were not merely a welcome to the Rising Phoenix Clan. They were also a warning-if any dared to retaliate against them for their choice, he would personally see to their destruction.

chapters.title: Chapter 2136: Immortal Monarch's Grand Blessing
paragraphs: After a brief silence, the Primordial Phoenix finally spoke, "Though I cannot punish you for luring the Rising Phoenix Clan to your side, I can certainly punish you for slandering the Celestial Emperor's name."
"Just because you refuse to believe it doesn't make it slander," Yuan replied calmly. "Still, if you wish to fight, I'll be more than willing to oblige."

The Primordial Phoenix silently swept his gaze over Yuan and the others in the chamber. Alongside Yuan and Feng Yuxiang stood Feng Lingyang, Feng Haoyu, and the Grand Elder. Though his cultivation surpassed them all, he ultimately chose not to act.
"You should be grateful the Celestial Emperor forbade me from touching you," the Primordial Phoenix said. "At least, for now."
Yuan raised his brows in surprise. "Oh? The Celestial Emperor told you not to fight me? How unusual... or perhaps he intends to deal with me personally?"
"The Celestial Emperor has far more important matters than wasting time on an insect like you." The Primordial Phoenix sneered, then turned and strode toward the exit.
"Of course, the same goes for me."
After saying that, the Primordial Phoenix left the room and disappeared from the summit shortly after.
"So... what now?" Feng Yuxiang turned to look at Yuan and asked.
"Let's return to the Rising Phoenix Clan for now," he said.
"Alright."
As they traveled, Yuan said, "I will fulfill my promise to you and strengthen the entire Rising Phoenix Clan. Once we arrive, can you gather everyone for me?"
Feng Lingyang immediately nodded in agreement.

Before long, they returned to the Rising Phoenix Clan's territory. At Yuan's request, Feng Lingyang swiftly summoned every member of the clan. Yet even before she could announce the results of their journey, the clan members already understood the outcome, as Yuan's very presence within their grounds spoke louder than words.
"As you may have already realized, your leader has accepted my offer. From this day forward, the Rising Phoenix Clan stands under my command.
"If you are unwilling to follow me, I will grant you the chance to leave now," Yuan declared. "There is no need for words or explanations-simply depart in silence, and no punishment will follow."

He then stood in patient silence, giving time to those who wished to go. After several minutes, a handful of figures quietly took to the skies, vanishing into the distance without a trace. Yet, despite their departure, the overwhelming majority of the clan remained.
"Anyone else?" he asked.
When the remaining members shook their heads, Yuan nodded. "Very well. As a reward for choosing to stand with me, I will bestow upon you all a blessing."
With a single gesture, Yuan directed his will toward the gathered clan members. At once, the heavens above bloomed with radiant golden symbols, each one pulsing with profound might.
"Those who choose to serve me, accept the Immortal Monarch's symbol. From that moment forth, you shall be my followers, and my decree shall be your law."
One by one, the clan members reached out to the golden symbols, allowing them to sink into their bodies and fuse with their Dantians.
Once everyone had accepted his symbol, Yuan activated another skill.
<Immortal Monarch's Grand Blessing has been activated>

In the blink of an eye, a wave of radiant power swept across the Rising Phoenix Clan. Unlike an ordinary blessing, the Grand Blessing etched its effects permanently into the bodies of all who had accepted his symbol.
"This feeling! My body... It's overflowing with power!"

Cries of astonishment echoed as the clan members suddenly felt their strength rising beyond imagination. "This is the Immortal Monarch's power...? Feng Lingyang mumbled, her voice filled with awe. However, Yuan shook his head and said, "This is just a simple blessing. The real thing begins now." Yuan pricked his fingertip, letting a stream of blood flow forth. It quickly condensed into a sphere the size of a fist, hovering in his palm. With a firm clench, the sphere burst apart, scattering into countless drops of crimson light. Guided by his will, one drop entered the mouth of every clan member present.
The clan members shuddered in ecstasy, their senses overwhelmed by the peerless taste of his blood, a flavor surpassing every delicacy they had encountered in their lives.
"I just fed each of you a drop of my blood. Soon, your bloodline purity will improve," he said to them a moment later.
"Just like that?!"
"If you can't believe it, you can test your bloodline," Yuan remarked.
"Hand me the Golden Phoenix Needle!" Feng Lingyang commanded loudly.
The next moment, one of the elders approached her with the needle in hand.
Feng Lingyang immediately tested her bloodline while everyone watched in anticipation.
When the results appeared seconds later, Feng Lingyang's hands went limp. The Golden Phoenix Needle slipped from her grasp and clattered to the floor as she stood frozen, her face blank with shock.
"Clan Leader?! What's wrong?!" the Grand Elder cried, his voice laced with worry.
"M-My bloodline..." she whispered in a daze. Too shaken to form her thoughts into words, she simply lifted her trembling fingers and pointed toward the fallen needle.
The Grand Elder bent down and picked up the fallen Golden Phoenix Needle, his gaze fixed upon the results.
"By the Heavens!" he exclaimed, his voice trembling as his eyes grew wide with disbelief.
The other elders hastened to gather around him. When their eyes fell upon the results, their expressions froze, as though their very souls had been shaken.
"91.2 percent?!" one of the elders revealed.

"What?!" Gasps rippled through the crowd as the rest of the members heard the result, their surprise mirroring the elders' reactions. None of them, however, knew the hidden truth-that Feng Lingyang's bloodline had long been weakened by a curse, a secret known only to the elders and a select few.
Therefore, in their eyes, Feng Lingyang's bloodline had only increased by two percent, not six percent, as her bloodline had weakened to 85.2 percent. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2137: Acquiring the Final Ancient Seal
paragraphs: "M-My blood! I must test my bloodline!" the Grand Elder stammered, quickly seizing the Golden Phoenix Needle after snapping out of his daze.
Moments later, his eyes widened, and he exclaimed with unrestrained joy, "90.9 percent! My bloodline purity has surpassed ninety percent! This is a miracle!"
Stirred by his words, the other elders hastily tested themselves as well. Sure enough, nearly all of them discovered that their bloodline purity had risen by four to five percent.

"My lord! With only a single drop of your blood, our bloodlines have undergone unimaginable growth! And to think the Celestial Emperor only offered us no more than three percent!" one of them exclaimed.
Yet even in their excitement, unease gnawed at their hearts, as the results seemed almost too good to be true.
"Immortal Monarch, forgive my boldness, but... what kind of drawbacks should we expect from this?" someone finally asked, instantly silencing the place.

The clamor of celebration died down at once, and every gaze there shifted to Yuan, their faces full of worry and realization. They all knew that although innumerable treasures existed beneath the heavens, many of them had effects that were more detrimental than beneficial.
Now that their excitement had died down and their minds had cleared up, they began wondering what sacrifices must be made for such a powerful boost to their bloodline.
However, what came out of Yuan's mouth in just a moment left them all stunned again.
"Drawbacks? There are none. You can enjoy your improved bloodline without such needless worry."
"Are you serious?" Even Feng Lingyang couldn't believe it.
Yuan smiled and said, "If you think I am lying, I can swear on my soul."
"T-That won't be necessary! We believe you. It's just... I didn't expect such an overpowered ability to exist... Maybe that's why the Celestial Emperor is trying to get rid of you."
Yuan chuckled. "If you think this is overpowered, just wait until I fully recover my strength."
"Recover? Are you injured?" Feng Haoyu asked in surprise.
"No," Yuan replied calmly. "I only reincarnated recently, so much of my power has yet to return."
"I see..." Feng Haoyu murmured.
"Anyway, I have fulfilled the first part of our agreement. As for evolving your bloodline, you'll need to wait until I recover more of my strength, as I currently lacks the ability to do so."
Feng Lingyang nodded. "Don't worry. We never expected you to improve our bloodline so quickly in the first place, much less evolve it.
"Thank you for your understanding."
"So... what is the plan now? What do you want the Rising Phoenix Clan to do?" Feng Lingyang asked.

Yuan's expression grew solemn. "For now, focus on training and familiarizing yourselves with your newfound strength. I cannot say when, but I am certain the Celestial Emperor and the other Royal Phoenix Clans will not stay still and will soon act."
Feng Lingyang sighed at his words, but she was not surprised. In fact, she anticipated something like this would happen and had already mentally prepared for it.

"I don't know about the Celestial Emperor, but the Royal Phoenix Clans will definitely come after our clan for humiliating and defying them. However, I doubt they will come after us anytime soon-at least not until they figure out your prowess and whether or not they would be able to get away with it."
"In that case, I'll leave the Phoenix Rising Clan for now and return later," said Yuan.
"I understand."
"Before I go..." Yuan looked at Feng Lingyang and made a beckoning gesture with his hands.
Feng Lingyang stared at his hand with a puzzled face for a moment before she finally realized what he wanted from her.
"G-Give me a minute! I'll grab 'that' for you now!"
Without another word, Feng Lingyang flew away, disappearing deep into their territory.
About half an hour later, Feng Lingyang returned with a spatial ring in her grasp.
"I'm sorry it took so long, but here is the thing you wanted," she said as she offered the ring to him.
Yuan accepted it and looked inside. Sure enough, the Ancient Seal was inside.
"Thank you."
With the fourth and final Ancient Seal in his grasp, Yuan could finally enter the Primordial Realm and meet with Xiao Hua's family-the Asura Clan.
"Can you tell me why you want the Ancient Seal now?" Feng Lingyang asked.
Yuan smiled and said, "The Ancient Seals only serve one purpose. What else am I going to do with it?"
Feng Lingyang swallowed nervously.
'I knew he wanted to open the Primordial Realm, but I wanted to believe the Ancient Seal had other purposes...' she sighed inwardly.
"Can I ask why you're trying to open it?"
"Some of my friends from the past are imprisoned within, and I intend to free them," Yuan said.
"But the Primordial Realm is filled with..." Feng Lingyang began, but she stopped herself before uttering the word 'criminal'.
"I know what you want to say, but not everyone inside the Primordial Realm is a criminal. The previous Celestial Emperors have imprisoned innocent people inside just for standing up to him."
"Alright. I won't question it anymore. I'm sure you have your reasons."
Sometime later, before Yuan left the Rising Phoenix Clan's territory, he said to Feng Lingyang, "If anyone dares to mess with your clan, don't hesitate to contact me."

Feng Lingyang nodded with a smile and said, "Don't worry. Our Rising Phoenix Clan isn't so weak that anyone could bully us. We didn't earn the title Royal Phoenix Clan by luck, after all. However, if we do encounter a situation we cannot handle, we will definitely request your help."
"Even if nothing happens, I'll visit once I regain enough power to evolve your bloodline."
"What about me, Young Master? Is there anything I can do for you?" Feng Haoyu asked.
"Continue doing what you normally do. I'll contact you if I ever need your help."
"As you command."
With that, Yuan left the Rising Phoenix Clan.
"Are we going straight to the Primordial Realm?" Feng Yuxiang asked Yuan shortly later.
He shook his head and replied, "No, I still need to prepare some more." (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2138: A Hundred Million
paragraphs: After leaving the Rising Phoenix Clan, Yuan traveled straight to his next destination to prepare for the Primordial Realm.
"The Abyssal Underground? You wanted to come back here?" Feng Yuxiang quickly realized where he was trying to go.
He nodded and explained, "I still need a few more million kills to complete my quest, so I might as well finish it up before I head to the Primordial Realm."
The Primordial Realm was filled with dangerous Immortals and even God Ascension realm cultivators. If he wanted to traverse it safely, he needed to prepare properly for it.
Some time later, Yuan returned to the Abyssal Underground. This time, instead of looking for a guide, he flew straight into the entrance, disappearing into the void.
However, instead of starting his hunt at the 300th level, Yuan went as far as the 500th level, where the creatures were all between the 1st and 2nd level of God Ascension.
Once he ensured there was nobody nearby, he retrieved the Baneful Abyss and began spreading the poison mist, quickly gaining kills again.

As Yuan remained inside the Abyssal Underground, word of the Immortal Monarch's return surged through the Nine Heavens like a tempest, shaking every beast clan to its core. Though everyone was skeptical in the beginning, the moment it was revealed that the Royal Phoenix Clans themselves had spread the news, every shred of doubt was dispelled.
"From what I heard, the Immortal Monarch vanished without a word after the Divine Heaven split, becoming the Nine Heavens. Where do you think he'd been this entire time?"
"I think only the Immortal Monarch will be able to answer that question."
"The Immortal Monarch's return has serious implications. I can imagine things will get chaotic very soon, especially with the beast clans."
"What do you think he's going to do now that he returns? Continue what he did in the past?"
"His goal in the past was to unify humans and beasts. Since we're co-existing with each other properly now, I bet he'll find other things to do."

As word of the Immortal Monarch's return spread to every corner of the world, it seemed as though the very heavens and earth resounded with his name, and for the next several months, one would not be able to go anywhere without hearing his name at least once.
Of course, in the realm of the beast clans, his name was uttered with even greater frequency, for the Immortal Monarch's legacy carried unparalleled weight among them.
"The Immortal Monarch may have returned, but the Nine Divine Supremes are still gone..."
"Haven't you heard? Dragon Goddess Yeyou has also returned.
"That's just one out of nine, though."
"The Eater of Stars is also alive at least according to someone who last saw it wandering the Starry Sky several hundred years ago."
"Isn't this an opportunity for us to replace those who are gone, though?"
"Replace them? You're delusional if you think you have the capability to become one of the Nine Divine Supremes."
"I know that, you idiot. However, it doesn't change the fact that their positions are now open, and we may see new ones soon."
"That is assuming the Immortal Monarch wants to replace them."
"Haven't you heard? The Immortal Monarch has already begun recruiting people to his side, and the Rising Phoenix Clan has already offered its loyalty to him."
"Huh? Isn't the Rising Phoenix Clan one of the Ten Royal Phoenix Clans?"
"Not anymore. They left the Royal Clans to join the Immortal Monarch."

Beast clans from every corner of the world began dispatching envoys to seek out the Immortal Monarch, knowing full well he would never come to them and that they would have to approach him themselves if they wished to stand by his side.
Meanwhile, somewhere in the Nine Heavens, a powerful pressure enveloped a vast area when a certain individual learned of the Immortal Monarch's return.
"What?! That bastard is still alive and has returned?!" The Great One roared, his voice loud enough to crack the space around him.
"I swear, if you're messing with me, I'll fucking rip you limb from limb!"
The messenger quickly replied, "I swear on my soul that it's true! The entire world is talking about it!
"Damn it! Why now of all time?" The Great One gritted his teeth in frustration.
Just when he thought he could pursue Dragon Goddess Yeyou in peace, his biggest competition made a return.
"Where?! Where is this bastard?"
"He was last seen at the Rising Phoenix Clan's territory, but nobody has seen or heard from him in a few weeks. Are you going to give them a visit?"
The Great One narrowed his gaze. Then, after a moment of silence, he responded, "Are you insane? Why would I seek him out when I don't even want to see that bastard? Get lost!"
"M-My apologies! This lowly subordinate will leave immediately!" The messenger hurriedly disappeared from his presence.
"Immortal Monarch... looks like the heavens are on my side and want to see me defeat you!" The Great One laughed out loud, his voice causing the air to tremble.
Two months have passed since Yuan entered the Underground Abyssal.
<You have fulfilled a requirement for the Unique Quest '???'>

"Thank goodness for the Baneful Abyss's poisonous abilities. Without them, this quest would have taken far longer." Yuan shuddered at the thought of facing a hundred million foes without its convenient ability.
Having completed this requirement, Yuan now faced but a single remaining trial before he could resume the use of Heaven's Supremacy.
"I will need to evolve my physique again before I can enter the True Immortal Realm."
He thought he would be able to force his way to the True Immortal Realm by consuming the Dragon Ancestor's Blood Essence, but it didn't happen. However, he did gain several new abilities as a result.
"Next stop, White Hell."
With his next destination decided, Yuan cleaned up the poison mist before leaving the Abyssal Underground. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2139: White Hell
paragraphs: White Hell-a place so perilous it earned the name Gateway to Hell. There were four such forbidden lands within the Nine Heavens, and Yuan had already explored one of them, the Vanishing Valley.

Being one of the coldest places in the Nine Heavens, White Hell is a vast expanse of endless snow and towering mountains, shrouded in extreme cold. The chill is so severe that even those with strong cold resistance struggle to survive in its outer regions, let alone venture into its depths.

And yet, in spite of its peril and the countless lives it claims, White Hell draws thousands of cultivators every year-some to hone their strength, others to pursue the treasures buried within its icy depths.

All of this was made possible by the Sun God's Temple, a unique sanctuary where cultivators gathered to cultivate their Yang Qi. They also possessed a powerful treasure that, while unable to eliminate the cold of White Hell, granted enough resistance for cultivators to endure its frost and traverse its perilous lands. This treasure was known as the Sun God's Lake, a small yet extraordinary lake within the Sun God's Temple's territory. Not only was it one of the most sought-after training areas in the world, but it could even evolve one's physique. Naturally, it could not be taken into White Hell itself. Instead, it was used to imbue Sun Stones, small rock-like objects that shielded their bearers from the cold.

However, the Sun Stones carried limited power, losing their effectiveness after a certain period of time. To obtain one, cultivators had to approach the Sun God's Temple and make an offering in exchange, whether it be spirit stones or treasures.
Right outside the White Hell's entrance, several individuals wearing the Sun God's Temple's outfit could be seen talking to a group of female cultivators.
"This here is the One-Year Sun Stone, which you will need to traverse White Hell safely."
In one member's hand rested a glowing pebble, radiating such immense Yang Qi that it warmed the air around them, even in the freezing cold.
"It has soaked in the Sun God's Lake for a year, and it will last for ten years while inside White Hell."

Then, he produced another glowing stone, pulsing with even more intense Yang Qi. "And this," he said, "is a Hundred-Year Sun Stone. It will last for a hundred years in the outer regions, and its might is sufficient to defy the cold of the second region, reaching even into the third."

White Hell was divided into nine regions, beginning with the outer region. The deeper one ventured, the colder and more perilous it became. As for the Sun Stone, the most refined ones could allow a cultivator to venture safely into the fifth region. However, each stone needed to be immersed in the Sun God's Lake for over a million years, making them unimaginably expensive.

One might assume the Sun God's Temple could simply throw countless Sun Stones into the lake to satisfy demand. However, doing so would drain the lake's power, and since its primary purpose was as a training ground, the temple was unwilling to create too many.
"I would like to venture into the fourth region," one of the female cultivators said.
"Then you will need a Ten-Thousand-Year Sun Stone, and it will only last you ten years in the third region," said one of the Sun God Temple's disciples.
The female cultivator nodded and calmly handed a spatial pouch to the man.
"Is this donation enough?" she asked.
The disciple peeked into the spatial pouch and nodded, "Yes, this is more than enough. Thank you for your donation. Here is a Ten-Thousand-Year Sun Stone."
He handed her the Sun Stone.
"The Sun Stone will begin to lose its glow when it's near its limit, so make sure you leave White Hell the moment you see it."
"I understand."
One by one, the female cultivators purchased a Sun Stone before stepping into White Hell.
A few hours later, another group of female cultivators arrived, their matching attire revealing that they belonged to the same sect.
"I'd like to purchase 23 Hundred-Year Sun Stone."
The woman leading the group handed a spatial ring to one of the disciples, who then quickly checked the ring and handed the Sun Stones to them.
Minutes after they departed, another figure appeared at the entrance. This time it was not a beautiful female cultivator but a strikingly handsome man.
The disciples of the Sun God's Temple watched as he approached, expecting him to purchase a Sun Stone. To their surprise, however, the handsome man ignored them entirely and strode straight past.
"W-Wait a second! Where are you going?" One of the disciples subconsciously called out to him in a surprised tone.
The handsome man stopped walking and turned to look at him.
"Where does it look like I am going?" he calmly responded.
Another disciple spoke, "Do you already have a Sun Stone?"
"A what?"
The disciples were baffled by this man's ignorance. How could one even think about entering White Hell without their Sun Stone?
"You don't even know what a Sun Stone is, and you're attempting to challenge White Hell? Are you courting death?"
"Listen here. The White Hell is a place where even cultivators with Cold Immunities are helpless. The only way you can traverse White Hell is with the help of the Sun God Temple's Sun Stone."
The handsome man smiled and asked, "So, the Sun Stone keeps me safe from the cold within White Hell, is that correct?"
"That's right."
"If you want-"
The man interrupted and said, "In that case, I don't need it."
"Excuse me?"
The disciples' eyes widened with surprise, wondering if they'd misheard him.
"I came to White Hell to train, so the Sun Stone will only hinder me. Now, if you will excuse me."

Before the disciples could even open their mouths again, the handsome man turned around and continued moving toward White Hell, quickly vanishing into the snowstorm. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2140: White Hell(2)
paragraphs: "What a fool. What can he do without the Sun Stone? Even if he has Cold Resistance, he won't be able to withstand the cold enough to train properly." The disciples of the Sun God's Temple shook their heads at the handsome man who refused to heed their warning.
"Forget it. There will always be arrogant people like that."
"I doubt we'll ever see him again."

Unbeknownst to the disciples, the handsome man-Yuan-had no need for their Sun Stone. With the power of the Primordial Phoenix flowing within him, the cold of White Hell posed no threat. No matter how frigid its depths, his True Primordial Fire could easily protect him.

As Yuan crossed into the first region, he officially stepped into White Hell. The outer region stretched out as endless white plains buried beneath layers of snow. The drifts were so deep that walking on the ground was impossible, and only by flying through the skies could one traverse the land.
<Your Cold Resistance has improved slightly>

Despite possessing Supreme Cold Immunity-enough to remain unaffected even by the Extreme Yin Lake near the Frozen Cloud Ethereal Sect-the cold of White Hell was so intense that it had already begun tempering his resistance further.
"This place sure is great. I'd just stepped into it, and my cold resistance is already improving with every passing second." Yuan mumbled with a satisfied smile on his face.
"White Hell... it's been a long time since I last heard that name," Yu Ning remarked. "I had nearly forgotten this place even existed until you mentioned it."
"What was it like during the Primordial Era?" Yuan asked.

"I doubt much has changed," Yu Ning replied. "White Hell has been infamous for as long as I can remember. Back then, during the Primordial Era, the deepest anyone managed to reach was the third region."

"I've never been here before, so I don't know how impressive that is, but according to what those disciples from the Sun God's Temple said, their Sun Stones could help one survive even the fourth region."
Yuan had been listening to the disciples marketing the Sun Stones and only pretended to be ignorant.
"Sun God's Lake, huh? I would like to visit it in the future when I have the chance."

After reaching the midway point of the first region, Yuan noticed a group of cultivators slightly ahead of him. Though the snowstorm blanketed the world in white, his divine sense cut through it with ease.
Since he wasn't hiding his presence, the group ahead also noticed him.
"Am I seeing things, or is that man really traveling through White Hell without Sun Stone?" one of the women asked aloud, clutching the glowing stone in her hand.
"Even if he has Cold Immunity, what a reckless thing to do."
"He's probably just lingering in the first region."
In truth, every woman in the group possessed some degree of Cold Immunity. Had they not intended to enter the deeper regions, they wouldn't have needed to rely on Sun Stones at all.
However, as they drew closer to the second region, the group was astonished to see Yuan still right behind them, almost as if he intended to enter the second region as well.
Yet, they still believed that Yuan would not venture into the second region.

A week later, they arrived at the threshold of the second region, where the snowstorm transformed into a barrage of hail. Razor-sharp ice shards constantly rained down, and without the protection of spiritual energy, they could pierce flesh as easily as ordinary Sword Aura, riddling one's body with holes.

Naturally, the cold within the second region was far more severe, being at least two to three times harsher than that of the outer region. Mountains also began to emerge, though only one appeared every few days along their path.
"Heavens! Look over there! That man actually stepped into the second region without a Sun Stone, and he isn't even protecting his body with spiritual energy!"
The group stared in shock, their curiosity toward him rapidly intensifying.
"Is he just trying to show off to impress us or something?" one of the women muttered.
"That's likely."
"How typical.
"Let's see how long he'll last."

While the others chuckled at their own misunderstanding, the one leading them in the front remained silent, quietly observing Yuan through her divine sense to ensure he wasn't up to anything suspicious.

As they ventured deeper into the second region, magical beasts began to appear, many concealed beneath the snow, striking from ambush. With danger lurking at every step, the women soon stopped paying attention to Yuan, turning their focus entirely to their own safety.
Of course, a few of them couldn't resist sneaking glances at Yuan, who trailed behind in silence, almost like a stalker. That said, there were still thousands of miles separating them.
Eventually, one of them realized that no magical beasts had attacked Yuan for several days, even though their own group was assaulted constantly.
This left them greatly puzzled. Yuan made no attempt to conceal his presence, nor employed any special means, yet for reasons beyond their understanding, the magical beasts left him untouched.
"Why aren't the magical beasts attacking him?" one of them finally asked.
"What if... he's not trying to impress us, but instead using us as bait?" another suggested cautiously.
"Elder, should we question him? He's only a Golden Immortal, so I doubt he can do anything to us, but I have a bad feeling about him."
The woman leading them said calmly, "We've been moving in a straight line since entering White Hell-it might just be a coincidence. If you're that concerned, we can stop and let him pass us."
The others agreed with her suggestion and chose to rest. They carved out a massive crater in the snow before settling down inside it.
A few minutes later, Yuan had caught up to them. They silently hoped he would keep flying past, but their expressions darkened when he suddenly stopped directly above them.
"I knew it! He's up to no good!" one of the ladies hastily exclaimed. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

Yuan made no attempt to conceal his presence, nor employed any special means, yet for reasons beyond their understanding, the magical beasts left him untouched.
"Why aren't the magical beasts attacking him?" one of them finally asked.
"What if... he's not trying to impress us, but instead using us as bait?" another suggested cautiously.
"Elder, should we question him?
He's only a Golden Immortal, so I doubt he can do anything to us, but I have a bad feeling about him."
The woman leading them said calmly, "We've been moving in a straight line since entering White Hell-it might just be a coincidence.
If you're that concerned, we can stop and let him pass us."
The others agreed with her suggestion and chose to rest.
They carved out a massive crater in the snow before settling down inside it.
A few minutes later, Yuan had caught up to them.
They silently hoped he would keep flying past, but their expressions darkened when he suddenly stopped directly above them.
"I knew it!
He's up to no good!" one of the ladies hastily exclaimed. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2141: White Hell(3)
paragraphs: When the group of ladies noticed Yuan stopping right above them, they hastily retrieved their weapons and prepared to fight him.
"What do you want from us, you stalker?" one of them shouted at him.
Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"Stalker? Just because we're heading in the same direction doesn't mean I am stalking you. It's just a coincidence," he calmly replied.
"Then why did you stop? If you're not here for us, then hurry up and get lost!"
After a moment of silence, Yuan responded, "In that case, I'll stop bothering you and be right on my way. Sorry for the disturbance."
Without another word, Yuan flew away.
"What a creepy fellow."
"Right?"

Only after Yuan's presence vanished entirely did the group allow themselves to breathe freely, settling back into their rest. However, their rest was short-lived, as the earth beneath them quaked without warning, sending a jolt of alarm through the group.
"W-What's going on?!"
The leader's voice rang out sharply, "An ambush! Take to the air!"
At that instant, the ground split wide, and from its depths burst a colossal serpent, its body clad in translucent scales that gleamed like sculpted ice.
"It's a White Hell Glacial Serpent! The strongest magical beast in the second region! Run! We don't stand a chance against a monster like that!"
"S-Scatter!"
The group quickly scattered in different directions, hoping to confuse the serpent. But the beast was swift and decisive, striking immediately at the weakest among them.
Unfortunately, there was nothing anyone could do for her. After several moments of desperate struggle, the female cultivator was devoured by the beast.
However, the beast was not satisfied and immediately chased after its next prey.
In truth, Yuan had noticed the magical beast and wanted to warn them, but they chased him away before he could do so, even calling him a stalker.

A few days later, Yuan stepped into the third region. Here, the hail grew even more violent, its force great enough to pierce through ordinary spiritual energy. To withstand it, one needed Immortal Qi-making this region accessible only to Immortal cultivators.
<Your Cold Resistance has improved>
Though his Cold Immunity was progressing much faster than the second region, it was hardly enough to satisfy Yuan, so he continued going deeper.
As Yuan traversed the third region, magical beasts at the Golden Immortal level would constantly attack him. Unlike the second region, the beasts in the third region did not fear his aura.
Naturally, none of them posed even the slightest threat to him, and all it took was a single attack with Supreme Sword Aura to one-shot the beasts.

Since he had come to train, Yuan didn't bother using Immortal Qi to shield himself from the hail. Though the ice shards couldn't pierce his skin, each impact left a layer of frost, freezing his flesh on contact.
<Your Cold Resistance has improved>

In the blink of an eye, a month had passed, and Yuan stepped into the fourth region. Here, the hail had ceased, and the skies were clear, yet the temperature had dropped even further. The cold was so intense that Yuan's body was continuously being frozen just by existing within it.
"Still not enough," Yuan muttered as he proceeded to make his way toward the fifth region.
Although his Cold Immunity had been pushed to its limit after consuming the Tear of the Azure Heavens, it still had not reached the realm of Cold Harmony.

A few hours into his journey toward the fifth region, Yuan spotted a lone figure locked in battle with a mammoth-like magical beast. The creature was nearly the size of a small mountain, and a gleaming blue crystal was embedded between its brows.

The cultivator was at the 1st level of God Ascension, while the beast was only at the True Immortal realm. Yet the extreme cold rendered her movements stiff, and much of her focus was spent maintaining a shield of Immortal Qi to protect her body.
Not wishing to disturb her, Yuan quietly flew past without stopping.
Some time later, Yuan finally reached the border of the fifth region. Even without stepping inside, he could sense that his Cold Immunity would be useless there.
Unlike the previous four regions, the fifth was a mountain valley, where a raging snowstorm howled between towering peaks in every direction.
After mentally preparing himself, Yuan entered the fifth region.
The instant he entered the fifth region, Yuan's body began turning into an ice statue.
<Your Cold Resistance has improved greatly>

Still not content with the progress speed, Yuan chose to advance toward the sixth region. Yet without a Sun Stone or other protective treasure, his body froze solid the instant he attempted to proceed. Thus, he summoned forth his True Primordial Fire, engulfing himself in its blaze as though donning a fiery armor, to withstand the frigid domain.

With the True Primordial Fire shielding him, Yuan's body instantly thawed, granting him freedom of movement once more. In fact, the fire's power was so overwhelming that he couldn't even feel the cold in the slightest.

Without hesitation, Yuan flew straight into the sixth region. The deeper one ventured into White Hell, the smaller each region became. While it had taken him nearly three months to travel from the outer region to the fifth, it required only a single week to reach the sixth.
Upon entering the sixth region, Yuan began searching for a suitable place to cultivate. After a few minutes of wandering, he settled on a random cave and stepped inside.

Once he was ready, Yuan extinguished the True Primordial Fire. The warmth vanished in an instant, and his body was immediately overwhelmed by the immense cold, freezing him solid like a statue and turning his very blood to ice.
<Your Cold Resistance has improved drastically>
Despite every inch of his body-even his organs and blood-being frozen solid, Yuan remained alive, forced endure the endless agony.
Time flowed swiftly, and before long, a year had passed. Throughout it all, Yuan remained encased in ice, an unmoving statue in the heart of the sixth region. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2142: White Hell(4)
paragraphs: One year... two years... three years slipped by since Yuan began his cultivation in White Hell's sixth region. For all that time, he remained a frozen statue within an unremarkable cave, one among countless others scattered through the land.
While he had spent most of that time alone, sometime during his second year, he received an unexpected visitor.
it happened one seemingly ordinary night, when a lone figure suddenly flew into his cave and crashed to the ground.
The intruder was a woman, her body battered with wounds and stained with frozen blood.

However, having fallen unconscious shortly after entering the cave, she remained unaware of Yuan's presence. For the next few days, she lingered in a fragile slumber, surviving only thanks to the Sun Stone clutched tightly in her grasp.
Upon awakening, her eyes fell upon Yuan, and for a moment she was startled. However, she quickly calmed once she mistook him for nothing more than a frozen corpse.
"Damn it, you scared me for a moment," she muttered, sitting up and leaning her back against the wall.
For the next several days, she kept her eyes fixed on the cave's entrance with unwavering vigilance, as though expecting someone to appear.

“I doubt they would be foolish enough to follow me to the sixth region...” she muttered. The next moment, she retrieved several recovery pills and swallowed them, beginning the process of healing her injuries. Although she could have hastened the process through cultivation, she chose not to risk exposing her presence and relied solely on the pills for recovery.
A few weeks passed, during which the female cultivator stayed inside the cave without once stepping outside.
"At this rate, I should fully recover in about a year..." she muttered as she looked at the Sun Stone in her grasp.
“I'm glad I bought this Million-Year Sun Stone after all... otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to hide in the sixth region at all," she sighed.

Though the Million-Year Sun Stone was considered most effective only up to the fifth region, it could still aid entry into the sixth if the cultivator possessed other advantages, such as unique physiques or powerful treasures. In her case, she had a heaven-defying physique that granted her powerful resistance to the yin element, naturally giving her cold immunity.

“Those hateful bastards... Once I recover from my injuries, I'l tear them limb from limb!" Once the female cultivator was certain her pursuers would not suddenly appear, she turned her full focus to recovery.

After ten months had passed and the majority of her wounds had mended, the female cultivator's eyes snapped open. A sound unlike any she had heard in this cave reached her ears—the sharp crack of ice breaking. Until now, only the endless howling of the snowstorm had filled the silence.

Startled, she stood and turned toward the sound reverberating from the cave's depths. But bewilderment followed, for the only thing at the far end was the frozen corpse, unmoving since the day she had first stumbled upon it nearly a year prior.

It had never crossed her mind that the frozen figure might still live. After all, it was completely unprotected, and not even a God Ascension cultivator could survive in this region without some form of protection.

When the noise ceased, the female cultivator cautiously approached its source. A moment later, upon reaching the end of the cave, her eyes widened in shock and disbelief. The ice statue she had long assumed to be a corpse was no longer frozen, and standing before her was a man, very much alive.

"Hm? Who are you?" Yuan asked with mild surprise, not expecting company the moment he awoke from cultivation. During his training, he had entered a trance-like state of enlightenment, fully immersing himself and remaining unaware of the female cultivator's presence until he broke free from the ice.

The woman could not bring herself to answer. She simply stood there, eyes wide and lips parted in shock, unable to comprehend how this man had endured the merciless cold of the sixth region without the slightest protection.
However, the woman quickly snapped out of her daze and stammered, "S-Sorry, I didn't realize you were alive. I hope I haven't disturbed your training."
"No, it's fine. I didn't even realize you were here until I woke up," Yuan said calmly, waving his hand in a dismissive gesture.
He then noticed her blood-stained body and asked, "Are you okay?"
“I... I will take my leave now."
Without another word, the woman turned around and quickly left.
Yuan silently watched her depart, making no attempt to stop her.
His attention shifted to the notification.
"How long have I been cultivating?" Yuan asked the others.
“Three years." Yu Ning calmly responded.
“Three years, huh? Not bad, but my training is not finished."

Although he had attained Cold Harmony, it had yet to reach its full potential. Thus, Yuan left the cave shortly after and began making his way toward the seventh region, determined not to leave White Hell until he achieved the highest attainable realm of Cold immunity.

Over the course of five days, as Yuan made his way toward the seventh region, he encountered only one magical beast. The sixth region's environment was so merciless, so inhospitable, that only the rarest of creatures could exist within its bounds.

As Yuan stood at the border of the seventh region, his eyes widened at the sight ahead. On the horizon, a titanic beast, mammoth in form, loomed, its massive frame so towering it rose above the tallest mountains themselves.
However, what truly caught his attention was not the mammoth itself, but the faint silhouette of a human, barely visible, seated upon the beast's head.
Yuan narrowed his eyes at the distant figure. Though he could not make out their features, he could clearly feel the weight of their gaze fixed upon him.
However, the gaze did not linger, and a moment later the mammoth disappeared into the horizon. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2143: The Demon Sealing Faction's Return
paragraphs: Once the colossal mammoth and the silhouette disappeared, Yuan entered the seventh region before looking for a random cave.
The seventh region was so frigid that even with Cold Harmony, Yuan needed to cloak himself in True Primordial Fire just to move. Without it, he would be frozen instantly, reduced to an ice statue.
Some time later, Yuan sat cross-legged within a cave and withdrew the True Primordial Fire, allowing the cold to engulf him—thus beginning his training anew.

Normally, it would take thousands, if not millions, of years to advance Cold Harmony to the next level. But Yuan was forcing his body to the extreme. What truly accelerated his progress, however, was his heaven-defying physique.

The Heaven Refining Physique was a one-of-a-kind existence, so rare that most cultivators had never even heard of it. It first appeared in the Primordial Era, when Tian Yang stumbled upon the Heaven Refining Crystal that granted him this physique. Yet, even after countless years and many reincarnations, Yuan still could not uncover the true origin of that crystal.
Stil, despite possessing the Heaven Refining Physique, Yuan would continue his seclusion in the cave for no less than a decade.

Meanwhile, in the Seventh Heaven, the members of the Demon Sealing Faction returned to the Super Perfect Physique Tempering Sect after spending over a decade training in the outside world, gaining experience as cultivators.
Once everyone had returned safely to the sect, they gathered to share their experiences. “It's been a while," Wang Ming said with a smile. "How was your journey?"

“It was a pain in the ass," Chu Liuxiang sighed. "No matter where we go, people are always trying to hit on us. And when we brush them off, it somehow always turns into a fight. Thanks to that, my combat experience is now through the roof."

“Fortunately, my group was made up entirely of men, so we didn't have to worry about anyone hitting on us," Shi Lang said. "Even so, we still ran into plenty of trouble—mostly cultivators trying to take advantage of us."
“You guys are getting into fights? Pretty much all of my encounters back away after learning of my background,” said Wu Zao.
The others looked at Wu Zao and sighed, "You're using Kelan's name as a shield? How are you going to gain experience if you avoid everything?
“It's not like I avoided every fight. I just avoid the ones I find a pain in the ass."

Once they finished talking about their journey and experiences, Wang Ming asked, "Hey, have you heard anything from Yuan? It's been a while since we last heard from him." Meixiu shook her head and said, "No, he hasn't contacted us since he went to this place called "White Hell’ for training."

Before they parted ways, Yuan gave Meixiu, Chu Liuxiang, and Yu Rou a communication jade slip, allowing them to speak with each other even across great distances. Still, not wanting to interrupt his cultivation, it was usually Yuan who initiated the conversations. “It's been nearly twenty years since we last saw him... and to think, back then, we worried when he was gone for only a few months," Wang Bingbing remarked.

“What can we do? As our cultivation increases, so will the time we need to progress. Although it's been nearly two decades, it oddly doesn't feel that long." Wang Ming said. “In the future, we might see each other once every few hundred, if not a few thousand years." Xi Meili said.
“This is just the nature of the cultivation world." Kelan, who was also there, remarked. "However, you'll quickly get used to it."
“That said... to think he'd go train at White Hell. He's truly the most reckless person I know."
“What's that place like?" Xi Murong asked.

“It's one of the coldest and most perilous regions in the Nine Heavens," Kelan replied. “There exist four domains that cultivators universally avoid, known as the Forbidden Zones. White Hell stands as the third most dangerous of them all. Unless you have a powerful physique or a Sun Stone from the Sun God's Temple, you can forget about visiting that place.”
"Have you ever been there?" Wang Ming asked him.

“I've been there several times for training. It's not a pleasant place, especially since I hate the cold." Kelan shuddered just from recalling his experience within White Hell. Sometime later, Hong Xiuquan asked, "Senior Kelan, what should we do next in our training?"

"Honestly, there's only one thing you can do if you wish to continue improving, and that is to train at other sects—ones better suited to your specific needs,” Kelan replied. "As much as I would like to continue guiding you guys, I have already given you all I can in the basics as a cultivator. From here on, you must refine your own specializations.”

He continued, "For example, Wang Xiuying—since your focus is Alchemy, I'll recommend you to one of the top sects for Alchemists. And Wang Ming, with your swordsmanship, I'l send you to a sword sect. It doesn't have to be a sect, either. I can find you personal teachers if you wish. Of course, if you wish to stay here, I won't stop you."
After a moment of silence, Kelan spoke, “I'll give you all some time to think over it. Once you have decided, I will speak with—
“I am willing to go!" Wu Zao immediately gave a response. "I am already noticing a drastic decline in my progress, after all."
Before Kelan could say anything else, the others also responded.
“I will also go," said Wang Ming.
"Me too," said Shi Lang.

In the end, everyone but Li Jinxi gave a response, agreeing to train at other places. "Alright, I'll speak with Senior Bai later. Not only does he have more connections, but he has much more experience in this field than I do," Kelan nodded.
“What about you, Li Jinxi?" he turned to ask her a moment later.
Li Jinxi pondered for a moment before responding, *I think I will continue training by myself."
"Are you sure? With your talents, you could easily get into the top sects with ease, even without our help," Kelan said, worried that she might be wasting her potential.
“I am," she confidently confirmed.
“If you say so..." Despite saying that, Kelan wasn't going to give up easily.
“Let's see if Senior Bai can convince her..." he thought to himself. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

“It's been nearly twenty years since we last saw him... and to think, back then, we worried when he was gone for only a few months," Wang Bingbing remarked.
“What can we do?
As our cultivation increases, so will the time we need to progress.
Although it's been nearly two decades, it oddly doesn't feel that long." Wang Ming said.
“In the future, we might see each other once every few hundred, if not a few thousand years." Xi Meili said.
“This is just the nature of the cultivation world." Kelan, who was also there, remarked.
"However, you'll quickly get used to it."
“That said... to think he'd go train at White Hell.
He's truly the most reckless person I know."
“What's that place like?" Xi Murong asked.
“It's one of the coldest and most perilous regions in the Nine Heavens," Kelan replied.
“There exist four domains that cultivators universally avoid, known as the Forbidden Zones.
White Hell stands as the third most dangerous of them all.
Unless you have a powerful physique or a Sun Stone from the Sun God's Temple, you can forget about visiting that place.”
"Have you ever been there?" Wang Ming asked him.
“I've been there several times for training.
It's not a pleasant place, especially since I hate the cold." Kelan shuddered just from recalling his experience within White Hell.
Sometime later, Hong Xiuquan asked, "Senior Kelan, what should we do next in our training?"
"Honestly, there's only one thing you can do if you wish to continue improving, and that is to train at other sects—ones better suited to your specific needs,” Kelan replied.
"As much as I would like to continue guiding you guys, I have already given you all I can in the basics as a cultivator.
From here on, you must refine your own specializations.”
He continued, "For example, Wang Xiuying—since your focus is Alchemy, I'll recommend you to one of the top sects for Alchemists.
And Wang Ming, with your swordsmanship, I'l send you to a sword sect.
It doesn't have to be a sect, either.
I can find you personal teachers if you wish.
Of course, if you wish to stay here, I won't stop you."
After a moment of silence, Kelan spoke, “I'll give you all some time to think over it.
Once you have decided, I will speak with—
“I am willing to go!" Wu Zao immediately gave a response.
"I am already noticing a drastic decline in my progress, after all."
Before Kelan could say anything else, the others also responded.
“I will also go," said Wang Ming.
"Me too," said Shi Lang.
In the end, everyone but Li Jinxi gave a response, agreeing to train at other places.
"Alright, I'll speak with Senior Bai later.
Not only does he have more connections, but he has much more experience in this field than I do," Kelan nodded.
“What about you, Li Jinxi?" he turned to ask her a moment later.
Li Jinxi pondered for a moment before responding, *I think I will continue training by myself."
"Are you sure?
With your talents, you could easily get into the top sects with ease, even without our help," Kelan said, worried that she might be wasting her potential.
“I am," she confidently confirmed.
“If you say so..." Despite saying that, Kelan wasn't going to give up easily.
“Let's see if Senior Bai can convince her..." he thought to himself. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)

chapters.title: Chapter 2144: The Demon Sealing Faction's Return(2)
paragraphs: "What about us?" Xi Meili suddenly asked, referring to herself and Liya, as they were both dragons.
Kelan gave her a stiff smile. “To be honest, I'm not sure. I do have a few non-human friends I could reach out to, but I can't promise anything. Do you know of any place where you could train?"
Xi Meili fell silent to ponder, and after a minute of silence, she said, "I do have a place in mind... but I'm not sure they'll be okay with it."
Kelan raised an eyebrow and asked, "Where is this place?"

“The Holy Dragon Clan. I trained with them for some time when I went there with Yuan, and I really enjoyed it. If it weren't for the Celestial Emperor, I would've stayed there to train a little longer."

In truth, Xi Meili wanted to stay behind with the Holy Dragon Clan at the Dragon Spiral Mountain, but after what happened to them, she felt that it would be inappropriate for her to linger, so she ultimately decided to leave with Yuan.
“The Holy Dragon Clan, huh? In that case, I think it would be for the best if you personally reached out to them."
"Aren't they the ones at the Dragon Spiral Mountain?" Liya asked after recalling their name.
Xi Meili nodded, "That's right. You saw them right after arriving in the Nine Heavens." Liya recalled the mountain of corpses she saw and asked, "Do you think I can come with you?"
"Of course. It was already my intention to bring you along."
Kelan spoke a moment later, "I'l contact the others immediately, but it might take some time for a response. You can do whatever in the meantime.”

Once their meeting concluded, the members of the Demon Sealing Faction returned to their living quarters to rest. Many of them decided to log out of Cultivation Online to train their real bodies on Earth.
After logging out, Meixiu left her room to visit Yu Rou and the Eternal Lotuses, who had risen to become the second-strongest faction on Earth.
“It's been a while, Senior Sister Meixiu."
As she passed through, the members of the Eternal Lotuses bowed their heads, greeting her with utmost respect.

Although Meixiu wasn't officially part of their faction, she often visited to train them. The other members of the Demon Sealing Faction would also stop by from time to time, but with everyone following their own schedules, it had become rare for them all to gather together.
"Are you here to train us today, or are you here for Senior Sister Yu Rou?
The members approached her and asked.
“I'm here for Yu Rou today. I'l train with you all next week," she said.
"Okay!"
Melxiu arrived at their courtyard a few minutes later, where at the center stood a tall, beautiful woman instructing a group of younger girls.
The woman had long, silky black hair and warm brown eyes. Her very presence radiated a natural grace that drew people to her.
“Your posture is wrong. Move your hip a little to the right and straighten your back some more!"
“Yes, Senior Sister Yu!"
The woman was none other than Yu Rou.
Meixiu didn't disturb their training and waited for them to be done.
An hour later—"Okay, we will end our training here today. We'll continue next week at the same time. You are all dismissed."
As the group of females dispersed, Yu Rou approached Meixiu with a calm smile, "It's been two years, Meixiu. How have you been?"
“I just finished my journey and have returned to Kelan's sect for now. What about you?" “The same as usual. Training the newbies. Is it just your group that's returned?"
“The others have returned as well. Everyone is safe and sound."
“That's good to hear."
Knowing that Yu Rou will ask about Yuan, Meixiu mentioned him first, "Unfortunately, Yuan is still away," she said.
“Is that s0? Can't say I'm surprised,” Yu Rou replied with a bittersweet smile.
“You shouldn't be too hard on him."

“I would have been a little sad or lonely. I know he has a lot on his plate, but it's been nearly twenty years since I last saw his face. If you consider the other times he's been absent and how long we've been alive, it's about half of our lifetime."
“I know how it feels, but trust me, it will get better."
“I know. Anyway, what are you going to do now that you've returned?"
“I'm going to rest a little before I continue my training at another place." Meixiu proceeded to tell Yu Rou about Kelan's plans for the Demon Sealing Faction.
"So you guys will be doing your own things separately, huh? It makes sense, considering you all have your own talents and path.”
Sometime later, another presence approached them.
"Hello, Sister Lianhua."
"Hey, Meixiu." Bai Lianhua returned the greeting. "Mind if I join?"
"No, go ahead."

Bai Lianhua sat down beside them, and the three of them started chatting. After Meixiu recalled the end of her training journey, Bai Lianhua spoke about the Eternal Lotuses and Earth's overall situation.

Ever since Yuan opened the gateway between Earth and the Nine Heavens, flooding the world with spiritual energy, cultivators on Earth had advanced at a pace unlike anything before. Yet, no matter how far their cultivation rose, they soon discovered they could only wield the strength of a Spirit Grandmaster.

This meant that even Spirit King cultivators on Earth were no stronger than a Spirit Grandmaster. Since Yuan secretly created the formation that limited everyone's cultivation, nobody but the Demon Sealing Faction knew the cause of this phenomenon. Thus, much like the phenomenon of Cultivation Online, no one questioned it, choosing instead to continue their lives as usual.
However, Meixiu knew that things would not remain this way forever and that they needed another solution sooner or later. (More chapters in Buyers club for TMT)
